claim: Let \(K\) be the six-vertex simplicial complex with facets \(012,013,024,035,045,125,134,145,234,235\), the minimal triangulation of \(\mathbb{RP}^2\). Exactly \(6396\) vertex maps \(K\to K\) are simplicial. Their contiguity classes are exactly one class of size \(6336\), containing every constant map and every non-automorphism, together with \(60\) singleton classes consisting precisely of the simplicial automorphisms. The large class is exactly the set of self-maps inducing zero on \(H_1(K;\mathbf F_2)\), while every automorphism induces the identity on this one-dimensional group.

correctness.rationale: The ten-facet complex is checked to be a closed connected surface with \(f=(6,15,10)\), five-cycle links and Euler characteristic \(1\). The verifier exhausts all \(46656\) vertex maps, finds \(6396\) simplicial maps, proves that one-coordinate contiguous moves generate full contiguity classes, and exhaustively finds one \(6336\)-map class plus \(60\) singleton automorphisms. Independent boundary-matrix ranks over \(\mathbf F_2\) and an explicit nonzero cycle-cocycle pairing certify that \(H_1\) has dimension \(1\); evaluating every map shows exactly the automorphisms act nontrivially.

value.rationale: The object is the vertex-minimal triangulation of \(\mathbb{RP}^2\) and contiguity is a standard combinatorial refinement of homotopy. A complete exact self-map census is therefore a natural benchmark rather than an arbitrary slice. The \(6336+60\) decomposition reveals a sharp structural dichotomy: every non-automorphism lies in one null contiguity class while all \(60\) symmetries are isolated, and the same partition is detected by the induced \(H_1(-;\mathbf F_2)\) action.
